purpose: Make the pending-bundle audit and final acceptance fail closed by deriving every submission-relevant numerical and integrity gate from retained raw rows, tensors, checkpoint states, and immutable references. This correction authorizes implementation, focused tests, static review, and a new no-training prepare receipt only. It authorizes no optimizer construction or step, runtime smoke, game, packaging, promotion, or external write.
unchanged_hypothesis: The sole hypothesis remains a matched two-arm experiment from iteration004: identical Stage1, then 64 full-batch Stage2 updates for vanilla control versus mass-preserving deterministic PCGrad treatment. No architecture, representation, target, reward, row mass, feature, opponent, runtime, or game change is authorized.
v1_contract_retained: Specification-independent prepare and canonical byte-for-byte rebuild before Adam.
Immutable post-prepare execution specification with distinct confined pending and final directories.
Synchronized two-arm transaction and rollback rules.
Atomic PENDING_AUDIT publication with runtime-compatible checkpoints.
Separate load-only finalizer requiring numerical-audit and root-recomputation receipts.
Exact four-file terminal publication and no runtime or games before offline acceptance.
review_findings_to_remediate: Corrected finalization called a shape checker rather than enforcing the numerical priority, treatment-minus-control, family, global, raw-GAE, Monte-Carlo, sign-stable, control-failure, and END thresholds.
The pending audit checked gradient keys and dtypes but did not recompute PCGrad, the seven-task sum, KL addition, clipping, Adam deltas, or the cumulative parameter chain.
Direct policy and anchor-KL gradients and exact post-clip gradients were not retained, so load-only recomputation was impossible.
Step safety, surgery/touched tasks, control-update32, and duplicate-treatment booleans remained caller-authoritative.
The pending checkpoints were loadable but were not cross-bound to the complete update chain and checkpoint-recomputed 830-row outputs.
Stage1 branch equality did not compare both record hashes, complete reports, safety/value evidence, optimizer/model state, and all 830 diagnostics before Stage2.
The prepare receipt path in the execution spec was not constrained to a canonical repository-relative candidate test_outputs child.
Focused tests mocked the critical publication/finalization path and did not demonstrate rejection of self-consistent malicious evidence.

non_authority_rule.acceptance_source: Only the load-only recomputation result derived from exact raw evidence and immutable references may drive final status. Any mismatch between a caller summary and recomputation is itself a rejection and an audit discrepancy.

required_gates: All six treatment priority lower medians are at least +1e-6 at updates48 and64.
All six treatment-minus-control oriented lower medians are at least +1e-6 at updates48 and64.
At update64 every priority group passes ordinary, equal-state, and equal-trajectory lower medians at +1e-6.
The control still fails at least one priority direction at update64.
All 12 family-polarity medians strictly exceed +1e-7 at updates48 and64.
Global lower median is at least 1e-5 and alignment score at least 0.10 at updates48 and64.
Raw-GAE- and Monte-Carlo-oriented absolute-target-weighted global movement are nonnegative, and the 611 sign-stable rows have nonnegative lower medians.
All every-update KL, TV, finiteness, parameter, optimizer, value, unique-argmax, and configured PPO-clip gates pass; bound diagnostic milestones have zero clip-active rows.
Surgery is nonzero, touches each of the four audit-adverse tasks in updates1-16, and all six cumulative-delta projections are strictly favorable at updates48 and64.
Every END control is recomputed at its exact strict or inclusive boundary.
Stage1, control-update32, duplicate-treatment, pending-file, checkpoint, and transaction gates pass from raw evidence.

additional_required_tests: A complete-shaped raw bundle with every terminal numerical value just below its threshold is rejected one gate at a time.
Changing caller safety, surgery, touched-task, control32, duplicate, END, or offline-pass booleans cannot change the raw-derived decision and creates a discrepancy.

Changing one raw task-gradient element, projected element, direct-gradient element, KL element, pre-clip element, post-clip element, actual delta, cumulative delta, output probability, or value forces rejection.
The independent seven-task sum and all 64 cyclic PCGrad projections are recomputed and checked at exact tolerance boundaries.
A clip-active synthetic gradient verifies exact PyTorch epsilon-compatible post-clip tensors; the prior coefficient formula fails.
A retained Stage1 Adam state plus synthetic 64-update gradients replays to exact per-update deltas and final optimizer state; one-bit exp_avg or exp_avg_sq mutations fail.
A different valid 65-step checkpoint, a checkpoint with matching metadata but different tensors, and a checkpoint with matching tensors but different update64 outputs each fail.
A copied or fabricated duplicate summary fails unless the retained duplicate state, optimizer, outputs, and record chain equal the primary treatment evidence.
Both Stage1 record hashes, full reports, safety/value evidence, model/optimizer state, and all 830 rows must match before the production branch function reaches Stage2.
Absolute, aliased, backslash, dot, dot-dot, linked, outside-root, wrong-depth, and wrong-filename prepare receipt paths fail before optimizer construction.
Production pending publication and load-only finalization are exercised on deterministic lightweight tensor evidence without mocking the gate recomputation core.
Missing any required raw tensor, output row, offset, update, arm, parameter, task, checkpoint field, or authority binding forces rejection.
review_and_execution_stop_rule: After implementation, all focused and inherited non-relocation tests, root hash/prepare verification, and independent math and safety reviews must pass. The root must then author a new immutable execution spec binding the final snapshot and new prepare hashes. Until that point, construct no optimizer and run no training, runtime smoke, or game.
